# Supervised Learning

Supervised Learning - bu modelni kirish ma'lumotlari va ularga mos javoblar
asosida o'qitish yondashuvi. Maqsad yangi ma'lumot kelganda to'g'ri bashorat
yoki tasnif berishdir.

Asosiy yo'nalishlar:

```{toctree}
:maxdepth: 2

supervised_learning/regression
supervised_learning/classification
supervised_learning/knn
supervised_learning/decision_tree
supervised_learning/random_forest
supervised_learning/svm
supervised_learning/logistic_regression
supervised_learning/gradient_boosting
```

## Algoritmlarning qo'llanish sohasi

Ayrim algoritmlar bir nechta turdagi masalani yecha oladi. Masalan, bitta
algoritm classification uchun ham, regression uchun ham mos bo'lishi mumkin.

| Algoritm | Classification | Regression |
| --- | --- | --- |
| k-NN | ✔ | ✔ |
| Decision Tree | ✔ | ✔ |
| Random Forest | ✔ | ✔ |
| Gradient Boosting | ✔ | ✔ |
| SVM | ✔ (SVC) | ✔ (SVR) |
